retrieval_recall_at_5.label: Evidence recall@5, ticker given
retrieval_recall_at_5.note: BM25 over 145 FinanceBench filing excerpts, 150 labelled queries; without the ticker hint recall@5 is 44.0% (MRR 0.33, nDCG@10 0.38), so the structured hint does the heavy lifting

sentiment_coverage.label: Sentiment fallback commits on
sentiment_coverage.note: marketsage-lexicon-v0 matched 19 of 234 FiQA test sentences and was right on 89.5% of those; accuracy over every row 8.1% against a 61.5% majority baseline; ECE 0.24; FinBERT is the real path and is pending

brief_grounding.label: Brief claims grounded
brief_grounding.note: claim bullets whose reference resolves to a snapshot, evidence id or sentiment hash in the same payload; 5 tickers, 3 with no committed evidence said so instead of borrowing another company's

contract_conformance.label: Responses conforming to contract
contract_conformance.note: every tool response validated against the JSON Schema generated from the Pydantic models; Go decodes the same fixtures with unknown fields forbidden; schema file in sync

failure_modes.label: Fault injections handled honestly
failure_modes.note: named scenarios that degraded with an explicit warning or failed with a clean error and an audit row; none returned invented data

audit_completeness.label: Tool calls with an audit row
audit_completeness.note: replayed demo chain; 8 ok rows, 0 orphans, 8/8 envelopes carry source, mode, timestamp and caveats
